records.Name: Golden Beach
records.Information: Let the sand cradle you and the sun warm you from head to toe. Bask in the comforting, laid-back toastiness and you’ll be rewarded with a smooth, sun‑tinted glow.

records.Name: Online Game Store
records.Information: Special items can be purchased with city currency.

records.Name: Supply Hub
records.Information: A shared mobile warehouse available for everyone to use. You can also find gameplay intermediaries here and compete in casual matches with other players.

records.Name: Five in a Row
records.Information: Black moves first. Players then alternate placing stones. The first to line up five stone in a row—either horizontally, vertically, or diagonally—wins.

records.Name: 整备枢纽

records.Name: Longqi Village Market
records.Information: A vibrant market held during peak tea season in Longqi Village. People gather to relax and enjoy fine tea, creating an atmosphere of uniquely quotidian calm.

records.Name: Fishing Spot
records.Information: 青峦山脚下的天然湖泊，水质清澈，竹林环绕。常见鲫鱼、鲤鱼，偶有珍稀翡翠鲤。清晨薄雾、傍晚夕阳，皆是垂钓好时节。
